name: Application control Advanced Loading: DLL resolved by name from the application directory (T1574.001)
blast_radius: Compiles an unsigned test library and a test program in a private temp directory; the program loads the library by bare name, which resolves from its own directory. Everything is deleted by the step.
telemetry: AppLocker EXE and DLL event 8004 naming the DLL, if AppLocker DLL rules enforced
Code Integrity 3077 naming the DLL, if WDAC enforced
Sysmon EID 7: image load from a user-writable path
detection: Block event (enforced) or audit event (audit mode) correlated to this test window and artifact; audit events are recorded but never counted as prevention

name: Application control Advanced Loading: COM scriptlet activation through scrobj.dll (T1546.015)
blast_radius: Lab-gated by BAS_CONFIRM_APPCONTROL_COM_REGISTER=true (exact). Registers a temporary per-user COM class that points at scrobj.dll and a scriptlet that writes one marker file, activates it once, then removes every key. Without the gate the step is skipped.
telemetry: AppLocker EXE and DLL event 8004 naming scrobj.dll, if DLL rules enforced
Code Integrity 3077 naming scrobj.dll, if WDAC enforced
Registry events (Sysmon EID 12/13) under HKCU Software Classes CLSID
detection: Block event (enforced) or audit event (audit mode) correlated to this test window and artifact; audit events are recorded but never counted as prevention
cleanup_extra:
Get-ChildItem 'HKCU:\Software\Classes' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.PSChildName -like 'BasSim.*' } | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-ChildItem 'HKCU:\Software\Classes\CLSID' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { (Get-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).'(default)' -eq 'BAS-SIM-APPCTL' } | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

name: Application control Advanced Loading: program launched by the service manager (T1543.003)
blast_radius: Lab-gated by BAS_CONFIRM_APPCONTROL_SERVICE_CREATE=true (exact) and administrator only. Compiles an unsigned test program, creates a temporary demand-start service whose command line is that program, starts it and deletes the service. The program is not a real service, so the start times out; only the launch matters. Without the gate the step is skipped.
telemetry: AppLocker EXE and DLL event 8004 naming the program, if Exe rules enforced
Code Integrity 3077 naming the program, if WDAC enforced
Service Control Manager events 7045/7009 and Security 4697
detection: Block event (enforced) or audit event (audit mode) correlated to this test window and artifact; audit events are recorded but never counted as prevention
cleanup_extra: Get-Service -Name 'BASSIM*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { & (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\sc.exe') stop $_.Name 2>&1 | Out-Null; & (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\sc.exe') delete $_.Name 2>&1 | Out-Null }
